summary: Amalgamated Financial Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its Board authorized an additional $31.4 million in share repurchases, bringing total authorization to $40 million. The program has no expiration date and allows purchases in open market, privately negotiated, or block trades at management's discretion. No specific price, premium, or timeline was disclosed. The existing program had $8.6 million remaining. The issuer is returning capital to shareholders via open-market buybacks. Watch for pace of repurchases and any suspension or extension.
